_readme: Small config the agent reads/writes each run. artifactUrl is filled in after the first successful publish and must be reused (not regenerated) on every subsequent run so updates land on the same page instead of creating a new one each day.
pagesPublishScope: every run — uses GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN if set (scheduled cloud runs), else the local gh CLI
lastRunStatus: Weekly research run: two new opportunities founded. ai-collaboration-patterns-differentiate-early-career-value (score 3) from a KPMG/UT Austin field study (523 early-career professionals, via HBR) finding early-career workers sort into three AI-collaboration patterns that predict value-add better than credentials or test scores; linked to entry-level-hiring-contraction-mixed-evidence. distributed-deskilling-risk-widespread-ai-reliance (score 2) from a BCG Henderson Institute executive survey (n=70+interviews) documenting organization-wide skill erosion from AI reliance; linked to ai-talent-strategy-gap-retention-risk. Both are single-institution founding findings, correctly low-scored, flagged for corroboration next run. Also enriched genai-adoption-plateau-scaling-gap with an IDC MaturityScape Benchmark (1,900 orgs, ceiling unchanged at 5) and job-architecture-shifts-skills-based-not-role-based with an HBR hiring-criteria study (score unchanged at 3). This was a dedicated deeper pass on the four sources that crossed consecutiveEmptyRuns>=6 last run (HBR, BCG, NBER, IDC): HBR, BCG, and IDC each yielded and reset to 0; NBER found a real but inadmissible paper (macro-forecast, not IT-specific) and continues to 8. BLS newly crossed the >=6 threshold this run. Red-teamed all ten evidenceScore>=4 opportunities from last run; no new threshold-clearing contradictions found, all theses survived unchanged. Under-covered roles (Product Management 1, QA/Test Engineering 2, Data Engineering 3, Help Desk/IT Support 3) searched again; specific leads considered and rejected are documented in the findings log — no admissible new evidence this run. Census BTOS and MIT CISR (priority sources) searched; both leads found were already in the trail from prior runs. Both the Claude Artifact and the GitHub Pages mirror published successfully (publish_pages.py and --verify both exited 0).
pagesTokenPermissions: fine-grained PAT, repository access limited to sdm1130/ai-it-research-tracker, Contents: Read and write (Metadata: Read-only is added automatically). Nothing else required: main has no branch protection or rulesets, and Pages is build_type=legacy on main:/ so it rebuilds on push.

pagesPublishExitCodes.3: no credentials — skip and report mirror stale
pagesPublishExitCodes.1: real failure e.g. expired token — report loudly
